# A key for the payments service is written in the code

The key the program uses to take payments is written into payments.js.

## Why it matters

Anyone who can read the code can take payments as you.

## What fixed looks like

The key is not in the code, and the code reads it from somewhere private instead. Change the key at the payments provider: only a person can do that.

# Checks of secure connections are turned off

The program does not check it is talking to the real server.

## Why it matters

Someone on the same network could read or change what is sent.

## What fixed looks like

Secure connections are checked.
